name: Britannia biscafe
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar (19%), Refined Palm & Palmolein Oil, Liquid Glucose, Maize Starch, Instant Coffee Powder (1.3%), Butter, Milk Solids, Iodised Salt, Raising Agents [503(ii) & 500(ii)], Colours (150a & 150d), Yeast, Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Emulsifiers [322(i) & 471], Dough Conditioner (223) And Improver (1101(i)].
